Kings of Kings Events

Rub-A-Dub Live – Dinner & Dance | November 8, 2025 | Toronto

Thriller Music in association with Kings of Kings International proudly presents Rub-A-Dub Live, bringing the legendary Rub-A-Dub Thursdays from Jamaica to Canada for the first time ever!

Join an all-star lineup of reggae icons including Icho Candy, Errol Dunkley, Professor Nuts, Original Thriller, Shalom, and Iley Dread for a night of authentic roots reggae, dancehall, and foundation vibes.

The celebration continues with powerful performances by Miztriz, Majah Baines, Mel C, Genuine Affection, Wayne Passion, and Fada Price — plus special guests and surprise appearances throughout the evening.

🍽️ Dinner & Dance Experience

Enjoy a complimentary soup from 7 PM – 10 PM as part of your all-inclusive ticket.

📅 Date: Saturday, November 8, 2025

🕖 Time: 7 PM – 10 PM showtime

📍 Venue: Spade Bar & Lounge, 3580 McNicoll Ave, Toronto, Ontario

🎟️ Early Bird VIP All-Inclusive Tickets: $75 (More at the door)

🎫 Tickets available online at TicketGateway.com

Experience a true Jamaican-style rub-a-dub dance right here in Toronto — food, culture, and legendary music all in one unforgettable night.

 

Icho Candy Live in Toronto – November 7, 2025

 

 

For the first time in Canada, legendary Rub-A-Dub Thursday singer Icho Candy takes the stage in Toronto for an unforgettable reggae night presented by Thriller Music alongside Kings of Kings International.

 

Joining him will be reggae greats Errol Dunkley, Original Thriller, Donna Makeda, Iley Dread, Mel C., and Kalico, with MC Delroy G (from Flow FM) and DJ Wiz (from 105.5 FM) keeping the vibes high. Expect surprise international guest appearances and authentic roots, lovers rock, and dancehall energy all night.

 

🎶 Music by: Kings of Kings Sounds & Routzman Sounds

📅 Date: Friday, November 7, 2025

📍 Venue: J.C.A. – 995 Arrow Rd, Toronto, Ontario

🎟️ Advance Tickets: $30  (More at the door)

💃 Ladies Free Before 10 PM

🍴 Complimentary Meal with Tickets from 8 PM – 10 PM

 

Tickets available at local outlets or online via TicketGateway.

For more info call 437 – 717 – 3406 or email thrillermusic@@gmail.com.

Get ready for an unforgettable Thanksgiving Sunday at the Reggae Ambassadors Day Rave, presented by Kings of Kings Int. and Farex Entertainment! Join us on Sunday, October 11th, from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the stunning Aquário Beach Club (949 Dillingham Rd, Pickering, ON) for an incredible afternoon and evening of live reggae heat. We are bringing together a powerhouse lineup featuring Turbulence, Jah Mason, and Marcia Griffiths, alongside live performances by Iley Dread, Angie Angel, and many more! Hosted by SpexDaBoss with tunes spun by Black Reaction, Jameel & Brenton B, and Soul Survival Sound, this is the ultimate fall celebration on Aquário’s comfortable heated patio.
Tickets are selling fast on TicketGateway—grab General Admission for $80 or upgrade to VIP for $95 (includes one complimentary meal; mandatory bottle purchase required). Don’t forget to save and hand in your event flyer at the door for an entry into our raffle draw, featuring a chance to win a Caribbean Cruise ticket courtesy of Celestial Travel Toronto! Secure your spot today here  and bring the heat this Thanksgiving!

Reggae Ambassadors Weekend – Two Nights. One Incredible Celebration.

Kings of Kings International proudly invites reggae fans from across Canada and beyond to experience an unforgettable Thanksgiving Long Weekend with two spectacular nights of world-class reggae entertainment at Toronto’s historic Phoenix Concert Theatre.

The celebration begins on Friday, October 9, with the Reggae Ambassador Series – 1st Edition, featuring an exciting lineup of live performances by Dudsymil, Belinda Brady, Kairo McLean, and a special appearance by Sister Nancy, one of reggae and dancehall’s most influential voices. Keeping the energy high all night will be DJ Wiz, Sir B, DJ Choppa Chop, Massaran, and DJ Mikey Don.

Then, the excitement continues with the Reggae Ambassadors In Concert, headlined by two legendary icons of reggae music—Marcia Griffiths and Sister Nancy—sharing one stage for a historic performance. They are joined by special guest artists Iley Dread, Jah Mason, and Angie Angel, delivering an evening filled with timeless reggae classics, powerful performances, and unforgettable moments.

Whether you’re celebrating reggae’s rich history or discovering its magic for the first time, this weekend promises incredible music, positive vibes, and an atmosphere that only reggae can create.

The Reggae Ambassador Awards Return – Bigger Than Ever!

Get ready for one of Canada’s premier celebrations of reggae music and culture as Kings of Kings International, in association with Plush Imperial, proudly presents the 2nd Annual Reggae Ambassador Dinner & Dance Gala.

Join us Saturday, October 10, in beautiful Niagara Falls, Ontario, for an unforgettable evening honouring reggae music, culture, community, and the people who help keep it alive.

Featuring a live performance by the Queen of Reggae, Marcia Griffiths, along with Jah Mason, Angie Angel, Iley Dread, King Fabulous, Mel Dube, Electric Boogie, Childish Games, Dreamland, and more.

This special evening includes dinner, live performances, award presentations, dancing, and a true celebration of reggae culture.

Taking place at The Caribbean Food Factory, this high-energy event features international DJs Tony Matterhorn and Iley Dread alongside the legendary Stone Love, delivering the true Kingston vibe live. The night also includes a special live performance and album launch by Iley Dread, with additional guest appearances, top Montréal DJs, and hosting by Richie B with live broadcast coverage. With tiered ticket pricing and a full lineup of talent, this event sets the tone for an unforgettable weekend of reggae celebration across Canada.

To order your tickets to get your advance reservation, visit Ticket Gateway

 

Kings of Kings International celebrates 31 years of reggae excellence with a major anniversary event on Saturday, May 30, 2026, at JCA, 995 Arrow Road in North York. This special night features internationally renowned DJs Tony Matterhorn and Iley Dread alongside the legendary Stone Love, delivering the authentic sound of Kingston, Jamaica live to Toronto. The event also marks the official album launch for Iley Dread, with additional surprise international performances, hosted by Spexdaboss and featuring live broadcast coverage with Richie B Radio. Early bird tickets are available, with VIP booth options for those looking for an elevated experience. Thriller Music in association with Kings of Kings International proudly presents Rub-A-Dub Live, bringing the legendary Rub-A-Dub Thursdays from Jamaica to Canada for the first time ever!

Join an all-star lineup of reggae icons including Icho Candy, Errol Dunkley, Professor Nuts, Original Thriller, Shalom, and Iley Dread for a night of authentic roots reggae, dancehall, and foundation vibes.

Experience a true Jamaican-style rub-a-dub dance right here in Toronto — food, culture, and legendary music all in one unforgettable night.

 

Icho Candy Live in Toronto – November 7, 2025

 

 

For the first time in Canada, legendary Rub-A-Dub Thursday singer Icho Candy takes the stage in Toronto for an unforgettable reggae night presented by Thriller Music alongside Kings of Kings International.

 

Joining him will be reggae greats Errol Dunkley, Original Thriller, Donna Makeda, Iley Dread, Mel C., and Kalico, with MC Delroy G (from Flow FM) and DJ Wiz (from 105.5 FM) keeping the vibes high.
